WITH trans_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trans_id,
    t.account_id,
    t.type,
    t.amount
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06'
),
trans_with_signed AS (
  SELECT 
    tf.account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN tf.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN tf.amount
      WHEN tf.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -tf.amount
    END as signed_amount
  FROM trans_filtered tf
),
trans_with_region AS (
  SELECT 
    tws.signed_amount,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM trans_with_signed tws
  INNER JOIN account a ON tws.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(signed_amount) as avg_signed_amount,
    COUNT(*) as trans_count
  FROM trans_with_region
  GROUP BY region
),
overall_avg_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) as overall_average
  FROM region_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.region,
  rs.avg_signed_amount,
  rs.trans_count,
  rs.avg_signed_amount / oav.overall_average as ratio
FROM region_stats rs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_value oav
WHERE oav.overall_average IS NOT NULL
